request.state:
KESTREL MARINE SYSTEMS AS — IT ASSET MANAGEMENT
Licence true-up worksheet: Tessellate CAD Enterprise, measurement date 31 August 2026
Prepared for the licence compliance review before submission of the annual True-Up Report to Tessellate Software Ltd (due 30 September 2026).

======================================================================
A. ENTERPRISE LICENCE AGREEMENT TES-ELA-2023-118 (signed 1 March 2023) — EXTRACTS
======================================================================
1. Definitions
1.1 "Software" — Tessellate CAD Enterprise, including the desktop client, the web viewer and the rendering server components.
1.2 "Licence" — a named-user subscription licence to use the Software. One Licence permits one Named User to use the Software on any number of devices.
1.3 "Licensee Affiliates" — entities controlling, controlled by or under common control with the Licensee; their use counts as the Licensee's use.
1.4 "Named User" — an individual human being who is authorised by the Licensee to access the Software and has an active account on the Measurement Date. An individual is one Named User regardless of how many accounts the individual holds.
1.5 Shared accounts. Where an account is used by more than one individual, each individual who used that account during the three months ending on the Measurement Date is a Named User. The Licensee shall keep login records sufficient to identify such individuals.
1.6 Service accounts. An account used solely by software processes through the rendering-server API, without interactive login, is a "Service Account" and is not a Named User. If an individual logs in interactively through a Service Account at any time during the three months ending on the Measurement Date, that individual is a Named User.
1.7 "Active account" — any account that exists on the Measurement Date, unless it was disabled or deleted at least 30 days before the Measurement Date.
1.8 "Measurement Date" — 31 August of each year of the term.
1.9 "Production Environment" — any installation of the Software other than a registered Non-Production Environment (see Amendment No. 2).

2. Grant of licence and restrictions
2.1 Tessellate grants the Licensee a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the Software during the term for its internal business purposes, up to the number of Licences held.
2.2 The Licensee shall not (a) sublicense, rent or lease the Software; (b) use the Software to provide design services to third parties other than its own customers under contracts for vessels designed or built by the Licensee; (c) circumvent licence controls.
2.3 The Software may be installed in any country in which the Licensee or its Licensee Affiliates operate, subject to export control laws.
2.4 Plug-ins developed by the Licensee using the Tessellate SDK may be used without additional licences, but each individual using them requires a Licence as a Named User.

3. Use by third parties
3.1 The Licensee may permit its contractors and outsourcing providers to use the Software solely for the Licensee's internal business purposes.
3.2 Contractors and outsourcing providers who use the Software under 3.1 are Named Users of the Licensee and require Licences, unless the contractor uses the contractor's own Tessellate licences under the contractor's own agreement and the Licensee has received written confirmation of this from Tessellate.
3.3 The Licensee is responsible for the compliance of such third parties.

4. Fees
4.1 Subscription fees are invoiced annually in advance on 1 March for all Licences held.
4.2 Licences added during a subscription year are invoiced pro rata from their licence start date to the next 1 March.
4.3 List price for 2026: EUR 2,340 per Licence per year.

5. True-up
5.1 Each year the Licensee reports the number of Named Users as of the Measurement Date.
5.2 The number of Licences held on the Measurement Date is the number of Licences under all Order Forms whose licence start date is on or before the Measurement Date.
5.3 If the number of Named Users exceeds the number of Licences held, the Licensee purchases the shortfall at the then-current list price, with back-dated subscription fees for 12 months.
5.4 A true-up shortfall of more than 15 Licences, or of more than 10 % of Licences held, entitles Tessellate to conduct an audit at the Licensee's expense.

6. Audit
6.1 Tessellate may audit the Licensee's use of the Software once per year on 30 days' notice, in addition to any audit under 5.4.
6.2 The Licensee shall provide login records, identity management exports and Order Forms on request.
6.3 If an audit reveals a shortfall that the Licensee did not report in its True-Up Report, the Licensee pays the shortfall at 125 % of list price.

7. Term
7.1 The ELA runs until 28 February 2028 and may be renewed for further five-year terms.

8. Support and maintenance
8.1 Support is included in the subscription fee. Support cases may be raised by up to five designated contacts of the Licensee.
8.2 New releases are made available to all Licences held; the Licensee may continue to use the previous major release for 12 months after a new major release.

9. Data protection
9.1 Login records processed by Tessellate for licence management are processed as a processor on behalf of the Licensee; they are deleted 24 months after collection.

======================================================================
B. AMENDMENTS
======================================================================
Amendment No. 1 (signed 12 February 2024)
B1.1 Named Users who, on the Measurement Date, have been on continuous leave of absence (parental, sick, sabbatical) for 90 days or more, and whose accounts were not used during that leave, are not counted as Named Users for that Measurement Date.
B1.2 The Licensee may transfer a Licence from one individual to another no more than once per quarter per Licence.

Amendment No. 2 (signed 20 January 2026, effective 1 March 2026)
B2.1 The Licensee may register one or more Non-Production Environments (test, QA, training) with Tessellate by submitting form NPE-1. Registration takes effect on the date Tessellate confirms receipt of form NPE-1.
B2.2 Accounts that exist only in a registered Non-Production Environment are not counted in the true-up for any Measurement Date on which the registration was in effect.
B2.3 Accounts in an environment that is not registered on the Measurement Date are counted in the same way as Production Environment accounts, and each individual is counted once across all environments (1.4).
B2.4 Non-Production Environments may not be used for production design work; misuse ends the registration retroactively.

======================================================================
C. ORDER FORMS
======================================================================
OF-1 (1 March 2023): 100 Licences, term 1 March 2023 – 28 February 2028.
OF-2 draft v1 (circulated 10 January 2025, not signed): 20 additional Licences from 1 March 2025.
OF-2 (signed 18 February 2025): 15 additional Licences, licence start date 1 March 2025, co-terminous with OF-1.
OF-3 (signed 28 August 2026): 10 additional Licences, licence start date 1 September 2026, co-terminous with OF-1. Purchase order PO-26-4471 issued 27 August 2026.

======================================================================
D. ACCOUNT INVENTORY AS OF 31 AUGUST 2026 (identity management export + Tessellate admin console)
======================================================================
D1. Production tenant "kestrel-prod":
  D1.1 Enabled named accounts (employees of Kestrel Marine Systems AS and its affiliate Kestrel Offshore Design AB): 96 accounts. Identity management shows that two engineers each hold two accounts (a standard account and an "-admin" account): j.moreau / jmoreau-admin; s.halvorsen / shalvorsen-admin. All other accounts belong to different individuals.
  D1.2 One of the 96 accounts belongs to an engineer on parental leave since 15 June 2026 (account not used since 12 June 2026).
  D1.3 Disabled accounts (still present in the tenant): 3 accounts disabled on 20 August 2026 (leavers: last working day 19 August 2026); 4 accounts disabled on 15 July 2026 (leavers). None of these seven individuals has any other account.
  D1.4 Shared account "cad-kiosk-01" (workshop terminal, hull fabrication hall): login audit (badge-to-terminal records) for 1 June – 31 August 2026 shows use by 6 distinct individuals, all shop-floor technicians. None of them holds a named account.
  D1.5 Contractor accounts: 8 accounts for staff of Pellam Engineering GmbH (piping design outsourcing, framework contract FC-2024-09). Pellam holds its own Tessellate subscription for its other customers; no written confirmation from Tessellate under 3.2 is on file. The 8 Pellam individuals hold no other Kestrel accounts.
  D1.6 Service accounts svc-render-1, svc-render-2, svc-render-3 (rendering server). Admin console: svc-render-1 and svc-render-3: API sessions only. svc-render-2: API sessions, plus 14 interactive desktop-client logins between 3 and 21 August 2026 from workstation WS-HULL-117, assigned to a.lindqvist (summer intern, employed 1 June – 28 August 2026; no named Tessellate account; intern's Windows account disabled 28 August 2026).
D2. QA tenant "kestrel-qa" (set up 1 April 2026 for plug-in testing):
  D2.1 9 accounts. Four of them belong to engineers who also hold accounts in kestrel-prod (counted in D1.1). The other five belong to software testers who hold no other Tessellate account.
  D2.2 Form NPE-1 for "kestrel-qa" submitted by IT on 2 September 2026; Tessellate confirmed receipt on 5 September 2026.
D3. Training tenant "kestrel-train" (registered Non-Production Environment, Tessellate confirmation of NPE-1 dated 14 March 2026): 12 accounts, all belonging to individuals who also hold kestrel-prod accounts.
D4. Web viewer guest links (read-only, no login): 41 links created in 2026. The web viewer's guest mode is licensed separately under the "Viewer Unlimited" add-on and does not require Named User Licences.

D6. Sample rows from the identity management export (format illustration; full export attached to the worksheet):
  j.moreau | kestrel-prod | enabled | employee | last login 2026-08-31
  jmoreau-admin | kestrel-prod | enabled | employee (admin role) | last login 2026-08-12
  k.ostby | kestrel-prod | disabled 2026-08-20 | leaver | last login 2026-08-19
  r.vinter | kestrel-prod | disabled 2026-07-15 | leaver | last login 2026-07-14
  cad-kiosk-01 | kestrel-prod | enabled | shared | last login 2026-08-31
  p.gruber.pellam | kestrel-prod | enabled | contractor (Pellam) | last login 2026-08-28
  svc-render-2 | kestrel-prod | enabled | service | last API call 2026-08-31, last interactive login 2026-08-21
  t.nyberg | kestrel-qa | enabled | tester | last login 2026-08-30

D5. Identity management notes:
  D5.1 Leavers' accounts are disabled on the working day after the last working day and deleted after 90 days.
  D5.2 Contractors' accounts are created on request of the Kestrel project manager and reviewed quarterly; last review 30 June 2026 (all 8 Pellam accounts confirmed as needed).
  D5.3 Engineers returning from leave are re-enabled automatically; the account of the engineer on parental leave (D1.2) was never disabled.
  D5.4 The kiosk terminal was replaced on 1 September 2026 by three named-login terminals; cad-kiosk-01 was disabled on 1 September 2026.

======================================================================
E. PREVIOUS TRUE-UP
======================================================================
True-Up Report 2025 (Measurement Date 31 August 2025): Named Users reported 109; Licences held 115; no shortfall. The 2025 report counted cad-kiosk-01 as one Named User and did not include contractor accounts (Pellam's framework contract started in October 2025 for piping design; the earlier Pellam engagement used Pellam's own premises and licences).
IT Asset Management working assumption for 2026 (from the 2025 method sheet): "count enabled named accounts in kestrel-prod, plus shared accounts as one each; test tenants excluded".

decision.instructions: Under the ELA as amended, what is Kestrel's licence position for the 31 August 2026 Measurement Date? Output the level index.
criteria: Compliant: Named Users do not exceed Licences held on the Measurement Date
